overview_description.description: TRM Labs is a blockchain intelligence company that helps financial institutions, crypto businesses, and government agencies detect and investigate crypto-related financial crime and fraud. Our products are trusted by leading companies including PayPal, Visa, FTX, Uniswap, Anchorage, and federal agencies such as the FBI and IRS. Every day, we tackle challenges in data engineering, data science, and threat intelligence to advance our mission to build a safer financial system for billions of people. To accomplish our mission, we have raised over $79M from JPMorgan Chase, Visa, Citi, PayPal, Block, Tiger Global, and Bessemer. Our team is made up of world class experts from the FBI, U.S. Secret Service, US Treasury Department, McKinsey, Coinbase, and top-tier tech companies. TRM is a remote-first workplace, with hubs in San Francisco, Washington, DC, and London.

product.name: TRM Blockchain Intelligence Platform
product.description: A blockchain data and analytics platform for investigating digital-asset activity, assessing risk, and detecting crypto-related fraud and financial crime.

product.name: Compliance360
product.description: A digital-asset compliance solution for transaction monitoring, wallet screening, entity due diligence, sanctions compliance, and risk management.

product.name: Investigation360
product.description: An investigation solution for tracing crypto transactions, analyzing blockchain activity, and developing evidence about fraud and financial crime.

product.name: Seizure360
product.description: A digital-asset enforcement solution for identifying, tracing, and supporting the seizure or forfeiture of cryptocurrency linked to criminal activity.

product.name: Supervision360
product.description: A blockchain supervision solution for regulators and other authorities to monitor digital-asset activity, risks, and compliance across entities and markets.

product.name: NatSec360
product.description: A national-security intelligence solution for identifying cryptocurrency activity connected to terrorism, sanctions evasion, cyber threats, and other security risks.
